Location
The property is located in Kells town centre and within easy access to the M3. Kells is a heritage town with excellent schools both primary and secondary; many sporting facilities to include golf, swimming, football; award winning restaurants, shops, hotel, pubs and a thriving local community. The Hinterland Book Festival and the Samhain Festival of Food & Culture are located in Kells and are examples of what’s on offer locally.
